title: Generic learned compositional computation without fixed Boolean operators
question: Can CASM infer and execute a hidden continuous operator from input-output demonstrations without receiving an operator ID or fixed task-specific operator table?
hypothesis: A learned operator latent inferred from unordered demonstrations, combined with a generic bilinear operator basis, will generalize to unseen operator parameterizations within registered continuous families.

benchmark.train_parameter_space: episode-local continuous parameters; held-out values generated by disjoint RNG namespace
benchmark.evaluation: new operator parameterizations and new query pairs; support row order randomized
benchmark.leakage: operator parameters and family labels used only by benchmark generator and post-hoc diagnostics

held_constant: same differentiable operator-basis architecture across all seeds
same support/query sizes and optimizer settings
operator ID absent from all model inputs
no target output or operator family label is exposed as auxiliary training supervision
no post-run hyperparameter or seed selection
leakage_rules: training and evaluation episodes use disjoint RNG namespaces
operator parameter fingerprints are disjoint across train/eval
query targets are generated only inside the benchmark environment
oracle controls are post-hoc diagnostics only

arms.name: learned_operator
arms.intervention: infer latent operator code from support triples and execute through learned bilinear basis

arms.name: oracle_operator
arms.intervention: replace inferred latent with benchmark-side operator representation

arms.name: shuffle_support_outputs
arms.intervention: permute support outputs independently of inputs

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; learned heldout MSE <= 0.02 on the aggregate and each seed <= 0.05; oracle MSE <= 0.02
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence for generic learned compositional computation on the registered continuous operator families
decision_rule.does_not_license: operator synthesis outside the registered families; open-ended reasoning; real-world multimodal competence; persistence; scaling

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but learned criterion fails
decision_rule.licenses: generic CASM capability not established on this benchmark
